India inks Rs 661.5 crore deal for BrahMos systems for Navy

India's Ministry of Defence has signed a contract worth Rs 661.50 crore with BrahMos Aerospace Private Limited (BAPL) for the procurement of BrahMos fire control systems and launchers for Indian Navy ships. The deal was finalized in New Delhi.
